sections.title: Modification and revision of notice in certain cases.

clauses.text: any tax, interest, penalty, fine or any other sum in respect of which a notice of demand has been issued earlier under section 289; and

such tax, interest, penalty, fine or any other sum is reduced as a result of an order of the Adjudicating Authority as defined in section 5(1) of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 (31 of 2016),

subsections.text_after_clauses: the Assessing Officer shall serve on the assessee a modified notice of demand specifying the sum payable, if any, and such notice shall be treated as a notice under section 289 and the provisions of this Act shall accordingly apply in relation to such notice.

subsections.text: The modified notice of demand as referred to in sub-section (1) shall be revised where the order referred to in sub-section (1)(b) is modified by the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal or the Supreme Court.
